Deploy a model and interact with it in the Foundry portal
the official AI-901 study guide, skills measured as of April 15, 2026

toc.title: Deploy a model in the portal
Chat with the model: the playground

html:
1What Microsoft Foundry is

Microsoft Foundry is Microsoft's platform to build AI agents, models and apps. It "unifies agents, models and tools under a single management grouping". Old name It was called Azure AI Foundry and, before that, Azure AI Studio; Azure AI Services became Foundry Tools.

Piece What it is
Foundry resource The Azure resource that holds your AI setup (one resource, with projects)
Project A place to organize your work: it contains models, agents and other resources your team uses
Model catalog The list of models you can deploy
Foundry Tools Prebuilt services: Language, Speech, Vision, Content Understanding
Foundry portal The web portal (ai.azure.com) to deploy models, chat, build agents and manage the project

Each project has an endpoint that your code uses, in this form: https://<resource-name>.services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/<project-name>.

Exam tip

. Resource = the Azure container. Project = your workspace inside it, with the models and agents you use. Code connects to the project endpoint.

2The Foundry portal

The portal has a "New Foundry" experience. Main areas named in the quickstarts:

Area What you do there
Build Catalog (model catalog), Models (your deployments), Agents
Manage Project details, users and access
Playgrounds Try a model or an agent without writing code

You need an Azure subscription and permission to create the resource. To let others work in the project, give them access under Manage. Beyond the study guide

3Deploy a model in the portal

Steps (as in the quickstart):

  1. Open the portal and your project.
  2. Go to Build → Catalog → Model catalog.
  3. Search for a model (for example gpt-5-mini).
  4. Select Deploy → Default settings (or custom settings).
  5. Note the deployment name (for example gpt-5-mini).

  • The deployment is what your code and the playground call. It has a name, a model and a deployment type (Module 3).
  • For most workloads, start with Global Standard.
  • You are billed for what you use, so delete deployments you no longer need. Beyond the study guide
Exam tip

. The resource is the Azure container, the project is your workspace inside it, and code connects to the project endpoint.

4Chat with the model: the playground

After you deploy, you land in the model playground.

  • Type messages and read replies: a chat you can try at once.
  • Edit the system prompt (Module 6).
  • Configure parameters: temperature, top_p, max tokens (Module 3).
  • Attach tools to test them: web search, file search, code interpreter.
  • Compare mode lets you test up to three models side by side.
  • Guardrails (content safety settings) can be adjusted. [Verify live]
  • There is also an agents playground for agents (Module 9).
Exam tip

. "Test a deployed model without writing code" → playground. "Compare two models on the same prompt" → compare mode. "Change how random the answers are" → temperature.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors wants a place that holds the models and agents its team uses for one solution. What should it create in Microsoft Foundry?

  • AA project
  • BA management group
  • CA virtual network
  • DA storage tier
Show the answer

Answer: A. A Foundry project organizes the models, agents and other resources a team uses.

S2A developer wants to try a deployed model with different system prompts before writing code. Where?

  • AThe Azure Policy page in the Azure portal
  • BThe billing page of the subscription
  • CThe model playground in the Foundry portal
  • DThe Azure CLI only, with no playground
Show the answer

Answer: C. The playground is for chatting with a deployed model and changing prompts and parameters.

S3Which is the first step to find a model to deploy in the portal?

  • AGo to Build, then the model catalog, and search for the model
  • BOpen Manage and delete the project to start fresh
  • CWrite a Python client first, before any deployment
  • DCreate a virtual machine to host the model
Show the answer

Answer: A. Deployment starts in the model catalog under Build.

S4Which value does application code use to connect to a Foundry project?

  • AThe subscription name only
  • BThe playground URL
  • CThe project endpoint
  • DThe tenant logo
Show the answer

Answer: C. Code connects through the project endpoint.

S5What name did Microsoft Foundry have before?

  • AAzure DevOps Services
  • BAzure Advisor service
  • CAzure AI Foundry
  • DAzure Monitor service
Show the answer

Answer: C. Azure AI Foundry (and earlier Azure AI Studio) became Microsoft Foundry.

S6Which feature lets a team test the same prompt against up to three models at once?

  • ACompare mode
  • BResource locks
  • CCost analysis
  • DTags
Show the answer

Answer: A. The playground has a compare mode for up to three models.

5.2 Recall questions

R1What is the portal address for Foundry?

Show the answer

ai.azure.com.

R2What does a Foundry project contain?

Show the answer

Models, agents and other resources the team uses.

R3What is the deployment type to start with for most workloads?

Show the answer

Global Standard.

R4What are the Build area's parts for your work?

Show the answer

Catalog, Models and Agents.

R5What was Azure AI Services renamed?

Show the answer

Foundry Tools.

R6What does the playground let you adjust?

Show the answer

System prompt, parameters such as temperature, tools and guardrails.

6Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Foundry platform for agents, models, tools; formerly Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI Studio
Resource and project resource holds projects; project holds models and agents; code uses the project endpoint
Portal ai.azure.com; Build (catalog, models, agents); Manage (project details, users)
Deploy Build, Catalog, search, Deploy, default settings, note the deployment name; start with Global Standard
Playground chat, system prompt, parameters, tools, compare up to three models, guardrails
